_README: Copy this file to .notify_local.json (same directory) and edit your
settings. The .notify_local.json file is gitignored so neither
destinations nor any other personal info ends up in the repo.
Free push notifications. Pick a long, hard-to-guess topic string
(anyone who knows it can read messages). Install the ntfy app on
your phone, open it, tap +, and subscribe to the same topic.
